problem.title: Read-Replication Lag Causing Read-Your-Own-Writes Inconsistencies
problem.prompt: Social media user profile update service routing write queries to Primary and read queries to an asynchronous Read Replica.
requirements: Operational Invariant: "Route reads to primary immediately following a mutation (or verify replica LSN watermark) to preserve Read-Your-Own- Writes."

stages.learnerPrompt: What catastrophic failure physics occur when capacity limits or downstream dependencies degrade under peak load?

referenceMaterial.summary: Failure physics analysis: Pod Rotated → JVM Caches Stale IP → Traffic to Dead Pod → 💥 Connection Resets.
failureModes: Cascading Failure: User updates profile bio and refreshes page. Read query routes to replica. Replica is lagging by 800ms due to heavy write replication stream. The user sees their old bio and repeatedly submits updates, panicking that the platform is broken.
Breakdown Chain: Pod Rotated → JVM Caches Stale IP → Traffic to Dead Pod → 💥 Connection Resets
Shedding Failure: Without fast rejection at the boundary, queued dead work triggers multi-second GC pauses, CPU thrashing, and cascading 504 Gateway Timeouts.
